{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA condemns the attack by the Trump administration on the rights of transgender and genderqueer people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A recent memo from the Trump administration proposes to establish a legal definition of sex under Title IX.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The memo from the Department of Health and Human Services would force government agencies to comply with a definition of gender expressed on a “biological basis”.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Department of Health and Human Services proposal would define sex as either male or female, determined by the genitals that a person is born with.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In cases of questions about a person’s sex, genetic testing would be used to determine sex according to the Department of Health and Human Services proposal.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Department of Health and Human Services proposal would cause great harm to transgender, intersex, and genderqueer people.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Department of Health and Human Services proposal reflects the administration’s sexist and transphobic positions.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The administration has sought to prevent transgender people from serving in the military.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The administration has challenged civil rights protections included in the nation’s health care law.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Federal agencies have withdrawn policies that recognized gender identity in schools, prisons and homeless shelters.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA recognizes this as part of the administration’s attack on human rights.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA encourages chapters to work with local organizations fighting against these proposals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
